column1: # Audited compatible Vulkan ABI transitions for Ocarina.
# To approve one, commit EXACT source snapshots from the old release under
# and dmsh_abi.h. vk_abi_migrate.py audits the transition against the current
# headers: only additive descriptor kinds, shader flag bits or module variants
# are accepted, and all old constants, enum values, structs, NVN common ABI
# and ABI_REV must be unchanged. Incompatible changes require per-key hashes
# from a new reference translation, not header relabelling.
# Current ABI unchanged: no migration is necessary; no row is approved.
